title: Chemical Evolution and Response of a Virtual Pancreatic Tumor (PDAC)
epistemic_notice: Computational hypothesis-generation experiment. Artificial chemical life is a mathematical abstraction; PDAC cellular and ADMET outputs are mechanistic/predictive estimates, never clinical proof.

scenario_a_open_evolution.name: Experiment A - Open Artificial Chemical Evolution
scientific_questions: Do heritable lineages diversify and occupy distinct spatial niches?
Does differential resource uptake and catalysis select dominant chemical families?
Are extinct lineages and ancestor-descendant mutations accurately preserved in the genealogy?

scenario_b_directed_discovery.name: Experiment B - Directed Molecular Optimization & Controlled PDAC Evaluation
scenario_b_directed_discovery.validation_gate: Exploratory candidate ranking only begins after verifying that known reference active Gemcitabine outperforms untreated control and benign metabolite D-Glucose under identical initial conditions.
